name: UWCSEA East
summary: Tampines IB campus serving east-side families with the same UWC mission as Dover.
body: UWCSEA East mirrors Dover’s IB pathway with an east-coast catchment — convenient for Marine Parade, Katong, and Pasir Ris households. Expect the same emphasis on service, outdoor education, and international diversity. Campus choice is often geography-led within the UWCSEA system. Photo-day and sibling-composite rules differ by campus — read the circular early and put order deadlines on both parents’ calendars. Dual-career note: residential camp and overnight trip consent clocks need a named emergency contact on the shared calendar before client week.
waitlistNotes: Apply early; campus preference is not guaranteed.
